therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: Hematopoietic stem cells and immune system
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Conditioning regimen to prepare for hematopoietic stem cell transplantation with different intensity levels
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Myeloablation and immunosuppression to enable donor stem cell engraftment
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Pediatric patients with high-risk AML and MDS
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Non-relapsed deaths by 100 days and event-free survival at 6 months

results.effect_size: Event-free survival at 6 months: RIC 5/6 vs MAC 14/15 participants
results.target_engagement_evidence: Alemtuzumab level on day 0: median 0.24 mcg/mL (95% CI: 0.16-0.32) in RIC group
biomarker_changes: Neutrophil engraftment: median 13 days for both groups
Platelet engraftment: RIC 38 days vs MAC 32 days
CD3 count at day 180: RIC 405 vs MAC 405 cells/mm3
CD4 count at day 180: RIC 171 vs MAC 199.5 cells/mm3
CD8 count at day 180: RIC 222 vs MAC 113 cells/mm3
subgroup_findings: Disease-free survival at day 100: RIC 5/6 vs MAC 14/15
Overall survival at day 100: RIC 5/6 vs MAC 15/15
Acute GVHD grade II-IV: RIC 2/6 vs MAC 8/15
safety_signals: Primary graft failure: 0 in both groups
results.dose_information: RIC: alemtuzumab, hydroxyurea, fludarabine, melphalan, thiotepa; MAC: alemtuzumab, thiotepa, fludarabine, busulfan
